name: Zagreb in a day
description_md:
Zagreb in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The day is anchored in Zagreb, located in HR.

This sightseeing walk features 6 sightseeing stops. The full day lasts about 7.7 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop. Walkers cover a distance of 3.5 km of walking between stops.
